title: Fixed initial route state restoration in the app SDK
summary: Architecture: the app router stores state in browser history; the SDK tracks routes so Admin can revisit them. Problem: the route map starts empty and forgets state saved before the SDK connects. Solution: seed the map with the current route and its existing history state before tracking later moves.
validation: Private unpublished SDK. Regression test revisits the initial route and checks restored browser state and popstate event. Proposed fix only.
